label: Artwork
help: Drop in one design or a whole pile - each becomes a cell you can cut apart. Paste a Lolly tool link (a share link from any tool - a name badge, a QR code, a card) and that tool renders live into its cell and re-renders whenever the sheet is opened. One design fills the whole sheet; several cycle across the cells. Tap any cell on the sheet to swap what is in it, and Batch or Multi-edit can send a whole run straight here.

label: Fill
help: Repeat cycles the designs to fill every cell of every page - one design makes a full sheet of the same thing, several make a mixed sheet. Each once places every design a single time and adds pages until they all fit - a proof sheet.

label: Pages
help: How many sheets to print. Each is the same grid; the designs keep cycling across them so neighbouring pages stay varied. Each once sets its own page count.

label: Sheet
help: Paper size. Picking one also sets the export page size, so the PDF comes out at true scale.

label: Rows
help: Cells down each sheet. Rows times columns is capped at 40 cells a sheet.

label: Gap
help: Space between cells, in millimetres. Zero butts them edge to edge for a single cut between neighbours.

label: Sheet margin
help: Unprinted border, in millimetres. The crop marks live here, and most desktop printers cannot print closer than about 5 mm to the paper edge.

label: Crop marks
help: Short lines in the margin off every cell edge, to line a guillotine or a knife up on.

label: Cut shape
help: Straight cut leaves the cells square. Rounded corners add a dashed die line around each cell, the sticker-sheet shape.
